findings.title: Team admin check requires both admin AND owner
findings.body: In addGuests.handler.ts the authorization computes isTeamAdminOrOwner as (await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...)). Requiring both means a team admin who is not an owner, or an owner who is not flagged admin, is denied. It should be OR. Consequence: legitimate team admins cannot add guests while the error appears as forbidden, breaking team workflows.

findings.title: Duplicate and case-variant guest emails bypass dedup filter
findings.body: In addGuests.handler.ts uniqueGuests only filters guests that exactly equal an existing attendee email and lowercases only the blacklist, not the guest. It does not dedupe within the request, trim, or case-normalize. Guests like [a@x.com, a@x.com] or [A@x.com, a@x.com] or blacklist bypass via case all pass, then createMany inserts duplicate Attendee rows. Consequence: duplicate attendees, duplicate calendar invites and emails, and corrupted attendee list.

findings.title: Original guests list sent to email helper instead of filtered list
findings.body: In addGuests.handler.ts the handler computes uniqueGuests filtering out existing attendees and blacklisted emails, creates only uniqueGuests in the DB, but then calls sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests) with the original unfiltered input. In email-manager.ts newGuests.includes determines who gets AttendeeScheduledEmail vs AttendeeAddGuestsEmail. Consequence: an already-existing attendee re-submitted in the request is misclassified as new and gets the wrong invitation email.

findings.title: Guests can be added to cancelled, rejected or past bookings
findings.body: In addGuests.handler.ts after loading the booking the handler only checks existence, never booking.status or booking.endTime/startTime. There is no guard against CANCELLED, REJECTED, or ended bookings. Consequence: callers can append attendees to meetings that will never occur, writing useless Attendee rows and triggering calendar updates and guest emails for an invalid event.

findings.title: Calendar attendee update uses requesting user's credentials
findings.body: In addGuests.handler.ts the handler fetches the booking with organizer user.credentials but then does getUsersCredentials(ctx.user) and new EventManager({...user}) with the caller. When a team admin or attendee adds guests, updateCalendarAttendees runs with their calendars, not the organizer's. Consequence: external calendar (Google/Outlook) update fails or targets the wrong account while the DB was already updated, leaving DB and calendar diverged.

findings.title: Unbounded guests array enables DB and email spam
findings.body: In addGuests.schema.ts guests is defined as z.array(z.string().email()) with no max length or non-empty check. The handler creates one Attendee row per entry and sendAddGuestsEmails fans out to all attendees plus calendar API calls. Consequence: any authorized attendee can submit thousands of emails in one call, bloating the Attendee table and triggering mass email/calendar spam and DoS.

findings.title: Invalid email error never clears after fixing input
findings.body: In AddGuestsDialog.tsx handleAdd sets setIsInvalidEmail(true) on validation failure, but nothing ever sets it back to false except Cancel. Editing the emails to valid values does not clear the flag. Consequence: the 'Emails must be unique and valid' banner persists even after the user fixes the input, confusing users and suggesting failure on success.

findings.title: Add-guests emails ignore disableStandardEmails settings
findings.body: In email-manager.ts sendAddGuestsEmails takes only (calEvent, newGuests) and never checks eventTypeDisableHostEmail or eventTypeDisableAttendeeEmail, unlike sendScheduledEmails, sendRescheduledEmails and sendLocationChangeEmails. Consequence: event types that explicitly disabled standard host/attendee emails still send OrganizerAddGuestsEmail and AttendeeAddGuestsEmail, violating host privacy and preference.

findings.title: Index as key mixes up email inputs on removal
findings.body: In MultiEmail.tsx the email list renders <li key={index}> with controlled EmailField values. When a middle row is removed via splice, React reuses DOM nodes by index. Consequence: values, focus and validation state shift to the wrong rows, so users can accidentally submit the wrong email addresses.

findings.title: Add guests offered for past confirmed bookings
findings.body: In BookingListItem.tsx bookedActions which contains edit_booking -> add_members is rendered when isBookingInPast && isConfirmed. The AddGuestsDialog and backend have no date guard. Consequence: users are offered and can submit new guests for meetings that already ended, creating useless attendees and sending invites for a past event.
